## 2025-05-15 - Streamlit Tooltip Visibility in Custom Dark Themes
**Learning:** In highly customized Streamlit themes (like 'Liquid Glass'), standard tooltip icons generated by the 'help' parameter often suffer from low contrast or are completely invisible against dark backgrounds. Targeting 'button[aria-label^="Help for"]' and its nested SVG is the most reliable way to apply custom accent colors and opacity for better accessibility.
**Action:** Always verify help icon visibility when using custom themes and apply CSS overrides targeting the 'aria-label' if they are difficult to see.
